ratios.facility: 2026 Revolving Credit Agreement, 364-Day Revolving Credit Agreement and Term Loan Credit Agreement
ratios.quote: Maximum permitted leverage ratio (1) 4.25 times 1.87 times

parsed.notes: The leverage ratio is total debt to deemed consolidated EBITDA, as defined in the credit agreements. The 4.25x limit is a step-down level that applies because the Axonics acquisition was designated a qualified acquisition. The base covenant is 3.75x. Consolidated EBITDA excludes non-cash charges and net cash litigation payments up to $1.160 billion since 12/31/2025; $1.143 billion of that exclusion remained at 3/31/2026. The same table appears twice in the excerpt (notes and MD&A) and is reported here once.
